articles.title: Record-Breaking T. Rex 'Gus' Sells for $50.1 Million, But Scientists Worry About the Future of Fossils
articles.summary: A nearly complete T. rex skeleton named Gus sold for a record $50.1 million at a Sotheby's auction in New York. The anonymous buyer's plans are unknown, leaving scientists concerned about research access.

articles.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Casts Comedy Veterans as Orion Pirates in Puppet-Filled Episode
articles.summary: The latest Strange New Worlds episode features Orion pirates turning the Enterprise crew into puppets. Comedy actors Rachael Harris and Joe Lo Truglio play the Orion captain and commander, bringing humor to the sci-fi series.

articles.title: Sabalenka's US Open Prep Hits Another Snag as 20-Year-Old Bejlek Stuns World No. 1 in Cincinnati
articles.summary: Aryna Sabalenka blew big leads in both sets and lost to Sara Bejlek at the Cincinnati Open. The 20-year-old Czech, ranked 35th, earned her first top-10 win. Sabalenka's world No. 1 ranking is now under threat.
